claims.legacy_claim: Native/physical plane origin is the triple-circle overlap / origin-one object.
claims.centered_resolution: Native centered X6 slice zero is the chosen Cell center (0,0,0); triple-circle overlap survives only as carrier-incidence provenance.

claims.legacy_claim: A selected three-axis plane is intrinsically a three-positive-ray object.
claims.centered_resolution: Selected native slice is an affine Z^3 signed sub-torsor with primitive directions ±e_i, ±e_j, ±e_k.

claims.legacy_claim: Nonnegative triples with min=0 are native point identities.
claims.centered_resolution: They remain a canonical relative/carrier observer section rho(z)=z-min(z)1, not native identity.

claims.legacy_claim: The min-zero observer address rho(z) alone uniquely determines the native signed point.
claims.centered_resolution: rho is lossy: diagonal common level is erased.

claims.legacy_claim: Observer address plus common level is lossless.
claims.centered_resolution: With mu=min(z), z=rho(z)+mu(1,1,1).

claims.legacy_claim: Endpoint displacement should be computed from independently min-zero-normalized endpoints/relative addresses.
claims.centered_resolution: Intrinsic displacement is raw signed q-p in Z^3.

claims.legacy_claim: Anchor-normalized clr(q-p)=rho(q-p) is an intrinsic directed displacement.
claims.centered_resolution: clr/rho is an observer quotient representative only.

claims.legacy_claim: The component-square gauge of independently normalized displacement is an intrinsic directed metric.
claims.centered_resolution: Intrinsic squared gauge is sum_i (q_i-p_i)^2 on signed displacement.

claims.legacy_claim: Squared signed displacement gauge is reversal invariant.
claims.centered_resolution: g(p,q)=g(q,p)=sum_i delta_i^2.

claims.legacy_claim: Native shortest step count is the sum of displacement components after positive normalization.
claims.centered_resolution: Use T=sum_i |delta_i|; the old formula survives only after absolute-value retyping.

claims.legacy_claim: Dominant branch is max of a positive/min-zero normalized displacement.
claims.centered_resolution: Dominant native axis is argmax_i |delta_i|; orientation sign(delta_i) is separate.

claims.legacy_claim: Physical direction/orientation can be recovered from a min-zero displacement triple alone.
claims.centered_resolution: Observer normalization loses common level and can distort reversal; keep signed delta.

claims.legacy_claim: Endpoint reversal can intrinsically change a length-25 segment to length 17.
claims.centered_resolution: 25→17 is a rho/min-zero observer artifact from re-normalizing reverse displacement.

claims.legacy_claim: Endpoint reversal preserves native quadratic gauge, L1 step count and shortest-path multiplicity.
claims.centered_resolution: delta reverses to -delta; |delta_i| is unchanged.

claims.legacy_claim: The N=25 physical shell has 9 points under nonnegative min-zero coordinates.
claims.centered_resolution: The 9 triples are an observer/positive-section census only, not the full native shell.

claims.legacy_claim: The centered signed N=25 shell has 30 displacement vectors.
claims.centered_resolution: Exact recomputation: 6 support-one and 24 support-two signed vectors.

claims.legacy_claim: The full physical BRC route mass on N=25 is 213.
claims.centered_resolution: 213 is the old 9-address observer-section mass.

claims.legacy_claim: The full centered signed N=25 shortest-route BRC mass is 846.
BRC route multiplicity can be treated as signed cancellation when displacement signs differ.
claims.centered_resolution: Positive/weighted BRC multiplicities remain nonnegative; sign is provenance/label, not coefficient cancellation.

claims.legacy_claim: Multinomial shortest-path multiplicity survives the rebase.
claims.centered_resolution: For signed delta, M=(sum |delta_i|)!/prod |delta_i|!.

claims.legacy_claim: Z^3/Z(1,1,1) is a valid algebraic quotient for the min-zero section.
claims.centered_resolution: Retain as a derived displacement/carrier observer quotient with explicit type boundary.

claims.legacy_claim: Diagonal-shift equivalence in Z^3 is native Cell identity.
claims.centered_resolution: Native centered slice does not quotient by (1,1,1); the quotient is lower-information observer/carrier structure.

claims.legacy_claim: A quotient/min-zero representative can replace a signed endpoint in later native operations without repair data.
claims.centered_resolution: Future native operations require signed endpoint or rho plus common level.

claims.legacy_claim: The local seven-cell patch centered at the historical triple-overlap point is the literal centered native neighborhood.
claims.centered_resolution: Centered native slice has Cell center plus six nearest signed neighbors ±e_1, ±e_2, ±e_3.

claims.legacy_claim: A six-neighbor centered planar adjacency survives as a structural local fact.
claims.centered_resolution: Retype the neighborhood around the actual Cell center using ± selected native axes.

claims.legacy_claim: Square/parity and affine trace identities that depend only on raw signed displacement remain valid.
claims.centered_resolution: Replace positive/min-zero variables by signed displacement variables and use absolute counts where path length enters.

claims.legacy_claim: Unoriented segment data should be a two-value intrinsic spectrum {g_AB,g_BA}.
claims.centered_resolution: Intrinsic spectrum collapses to {N,N}; any unequal pair is an observer diagnostic, not native geometry.

claims.legacy_claim: Current live plane consumers still require the legacy origin/min-zero semantics after the centered-slice rebase.
claims.centered_resolution: Audit at current main finds the named live consumers already retyped; no broken current consumer remains in this task's audited set.

audit_note: BROKEN_CURRENT_CONSUMER is reserved for a superseded claim still consumed as current. None was found in the audited live definition set at latest_main_audit_ref; historical claims are retained as archive/provenance or salvaged with explicit retyping.
